decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanP 00P 01P 02P 03P 04P 05P 06P 0774 Cavendish Road Flood Risk Assessment, dated January 2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than Six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate surrounding

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to the commencement of the use, refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site, shall be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162. In particular, waste collection vehicles must be able to get within 25m of the refuse storage point. Residents should not have to carry waste further than 30m.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

Notwithstanding the information contained on the approved drawings, prior to the commencement of the use, unless otherwise agreed cycle parking should be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of SIX long stay cycle parking spaces: o	in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike too	enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) whicho	must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofThe approved bicycle parking shall be provided prior to occupation and thereafter permanently retained. Reason: To ensure that sufficient provision at all times so that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or the conditions of general safety along the adjacent highway, or the amenities and convenience of existing local residents.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations and mitigation measures set out in the Flood Risk Assessment: 74 Cavendish Road Flood Risk Assessment, dated January 2026. The measures shall be fully implemented prior to first occupation and thereafter retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that the development is appropriately protected from flood risk in accordance with national and local planning policy.
